The per-rep purchase-order count now leaves out cancelled purchase orders, so your example gives Anna 2, Bob 1. The tests matching `*PurchaseOrder*` pass. I didn't add a new test for the cancelled case, and I didn't run the rest of the suite.

The change is in `DataStore.findPurchaseOrderCountPerSalesRep` in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`. I added `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'` to the count subquery, the same filter the quarterly report uses. I also noted the exclusion in the method's Javadoc. Reps without purchase orders still appear with 0, and the ordering is unchanged.

Nothing is committed.
